outcome.technical: INTEGRATION (plugins/audit/scripts/git/integrate-task.py): new `owned(root, paths)` asks every owner script `_evidence_io.FOLLOWER_OWNERS` names that the task tree holds (`plugins/audit/scripts/_deps.py`, `tools/check-rendered-artifacts.py`, `tools/capture-screenshots.mjs`) as `<script> --follower-for <paths>` and reads the FOLLOWER-OWED lines with `followers_in`. There is no hard-coded path list: an owner the tree does not hold claims nothing. New `reproduced(tree, base, records)` copies the tree's work (`git ls-files` after the existing `add -A`) into a mkdtemp scratch, puts every claimed path back at its BASE bytes, runs each distinct recipe there through the new shared `_evidence_io.run_recipe`, and accepts only an exact byte match with the tree's file. A needsBrowser recipe or a recipe of None is never run. `_integrate` takes reproduced paths out of the undeclared set: they are integrated, returned as `followers`, and kept in the state entry, so an 'already integrated' rerun reports them again. Everything else stays the undeclared-change decision, which now also carries `unreproduced` {path: why}, naming the recipe and why (exited N / writes other bytes than the tree holds / runs in a browser / names no recipe), and `browser` (the needsBrowser claims). The sentence appends each reason. render() prints a `follower:` line. OWNERS: `_deps.follower_for(path)` (map_follower now builds on it) plus a `--follower-for` CLI. That CLI spells the FOLLOWER-OWED line itself because `_evidence_io` sits above `_deps`; test__deps g11 holds the reader to it. Importing `_deps` from integrate-task would have added a module-map edge and staled PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md, which this task does not declare, so the owner is asked by command. check-rendered-artifacts: new `follower_lines(rels)`/`_copies_of(rel)`. A stale page prints a line for itself plus each COPY_PROVEN copy of it, with the source's recipe, so a stale example html now also names docs/index.html via examples/report.sh. A `--follower-for` CLI was added and the deferred _evidence_io import moved into follower_lines. capture-screenshots.mjs: `--follower-for` prints a needsBrowser line, recipe `node tools/capture-screenshots.mjs`, for paths under its output dir (docs/screenshots/). DRIVE (drive-phase.py): new `widen_task(ctx, state, task, paths, basis)` (scope + `audit-task note` basis + accept_scope) replaces two copies, follow_red_gate's inline widening and the `--answer widen` block, which also gains a note now. The follower recipe run uses `_evio.run_recipe`, and the drive's FOLLOWER_TIMEOUT is removed in favour of `_evidence_io.RECIPE_TIMEOUT`. integrate_member widens the integration's `followers` with basis `written byte for byte at integration by `<recipe>` (<owner>)` and re-gates, because commit-task-work refuses a verdict measured on an older scope (observed before re-gating was forced). An undeclared-change whose remaining paths are all needsBrowser claims is not a decision: the drive marks a widen with basis `written by `<recipe>` on the drive's follow` and prints follow_said with the member's tree. The next drive widens and integrates.
